question: outcome_summary
answer: The study developed a risk calculator (RC) to predict the one-year risk of suicide attempts among youth with bipolar disorder, achieving a test area under the curve (AUC) of 0.82, indicating good predictive accuracy. Over a median follow-up of 13.1 years, 27% of the sample experienced at least one suicide attempt. The RC identified ten key predictors that accounted for over 90% of its predictive power. It aims to enhance clinical care by alerting healthcare providers to individuals at elevated risk for suicide attempts, although it should complement clinical judgment.
